description.value: Medizininformatik Initiative - Modul Labor

name.value: Expansion Parameters Manifest

description.value: Pinned code system versions every ValueSet in this IG is expanded against.

name.value: Laboratory order: renal diagnostics

description.value: A laboratory order for renal diagnostics — creatinine and potassium in blood, albumin in 24-hour urine, creatinine and the sediment in spot urine. The laboratory report and the five laboratory test examples of this guide belong to it.

name.value: Laboratory report: renal diagnostics

description.value: The laboratory report for the renal diagnostics order. It groups the five laboratory test examples of this guide, performed on three specimens of the same patient. Its clinical reference time is the period from the earliest to the latest collection.

name.value: Laboratory result: albumin in 24-hour urine

description.value: Albumin in 24-hour urine, an excretion rate stated as a valueQuantity with the composed UCUM unit mg/(24.h). A valueRatio would carry the same information, but cannot be found with the value-quantity search parameter. The clinical reference time is the collection period, stated as effectivePeriod.

name.value: Laboratory result: creatinine

description.value: A quantitative creatinine test: valueQuantity with a reference range and a coded interpretation.

name.value: Laboratory result: creatinine in spot urine without a value (Data Absent Reason)

description.value: Creatinine in the spot urine of the renal diagnostics order. The urine sediment used up the specimen, so the test was not performed: its status is cancelled, dataAbsentReason states that it was not performed, and a note gives the cause. Without a value there is nothing to interpret, so the example carries neither an interpretation nor a reference range.

name.value: Laboratory result: epithelial cells in urine sediment (range)

description.value: Epithelial cells in urine sediment, a test whose result is a range rather than a single value (valueRange).

name.value: Laboratory result: hemoglobin (LOINC Ontology profile)

description.value: A quantitative hemoglobin result conforming to the derived profile MII_PR_Labor_LOINC_Ontology_Hemoglobin_Standard: Observation.code carries LOINC 718-7, a member of the computed ValueSet; everything else is as in the module's creatinine example.

name.value: Laboratory result: potassium from a haemolysed specimen

description.value: Potassium from the haemolysed blood specimen of the renal diagnostics order. Haemolysis releases potassium from the red cells, so the value is reported but may be falsely high: the interpretation-affecting property names the haemolysis, and a note says what it means for this value.
